instruction: A clean, candid lifestyle photograph captured in a medium shot at eye-level, set against a plain, neutral white wall indoors. On the left, the dark-haired woman in the rust-orange zip-up hoodie (R1) stands facing forward with her arms crossed at her waist, gazing directly at the camera with a neutral expression and dark red lipstick. Standing slightly behind her on the right, the light-brown-haired woman in the mint-green hoodie (R2) looks toward her companion with a soft, affectionate gaze. The light-brown-haired woman (R2) places her right hand gently on the dark-haired woman's (R1) left shoulder, while her left hand rests softly on the dark-haired woman's (R1) left forearm. The scene is illuminated by soft, diffused natural light from the front-left, creating gentle shadows and a bright, clean color palette with a shallow depth of field.
elements: R2 places her right hand gently on R1's left shoulder
R2 rests her left hand softly on R1's left forearm
